category.name: Tiles & Ceramics
category.description: Subway, zellige, porcelain, mosaics, crackle and stoneware glazes, terracotta.

materials.name: Subway Metro Tile
materials.description: Beveled running-bond ceramic subway tiles with recessed sanded grout. Glazed ceramic wall tiles with bevelled edges and recessed sanded grout.

projection.tiling_note: Planar UVs with courses horizontal; never triplanar (grout lines would shear at corners).
projection.triplanar_scale_formula: triplanar_scale = 1 / 0.6 (texture tiles per meter along U), 1 / 0.6 along V

recommended_weathering.note: Glazed faces stay bright while grout darkens with kitchen grease and soap scum.
